specs.title: LLM settings use separate model lookup and validated agent capabilities
instruction links auto-fill once and multiple links require a choice
native agent requests necessary materials and automatically generates twelve images
refine a finished image keeps the previous version and stays off the workbench
set images open in a large viewer with keyboard and button navigation
failed result downloads show the cause and bulk retry never regenerates
